name: photo-magic
description: One-sentence photo retoucher powered by local AI image-to-image on Intel AIPC

displayDescription.en: Local AI photo editing for background swaps, mark and clutter removal, ID photos, product scenes, natural portraits, and old-photo restoration.
displayDescription.zh: 一句话本地修图，支持换背景、去标记、证件照换底、去杂物、商品场景、人像美颜和老照片修复。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请将这张照片的背景替换为海边日落场景，严格保留人物/主体的外形、姿态与细节不变，并使新背景与主体光影自然衔接
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please replace the background of this photo with a beach sunset. Keep the subject’s appearance, pose, and details unchanged, and blend the new background with natural lighting

quickPrompts.en: Please replace the background of this photo with a beach sunset. Keep the subject’s appearance, pose, and details unchanged, and blend the new background with natural lighting
quickPrompts.zh: 请将这张照片的背景替换为海边日落场景，严格保留人物/主体的外形、姿态与细节不变，并使新背景与主体光影自然衔接

quickPrompts.en: Please remove the mark or timestamp that I own or am authorized to edit, reconstruct the covered area naturally, and preserve the rest of the image
quickPrompts.zh: 请移除这张图片中由我拥有或已获授权处理的标记/时间戳，自然补全被遮挡区域，并尽量保持其余画面不变

quickPrompts.en: Please change this ID photo background to solid blue. Keep the person’s facial features, face shape, hairstyle, clothing, and identity unchanged
quickPrompts.zh: 请将这张证件照的背景更换为纯蓝色，保持人物五官、脸型、发型、服装和身份特征不变

quickPrompts.en: Please remove the distracting objects from this photo, reconstruct the background naturally, and preserve the main subject and composition
quickPrompts.zh: 请移除这张照片中的杂物和干扰元素，自然补全背景，并尽量保留主体和原有构图

quickPrompts.en: Please place this product in a clean studio setting with natural commercial lighting. Preserve the product’s shape, color, packaging, and visible details as much as possible
quickPrompts.zh: 请将这张普通商品照改成干净的摄影棚场景，使用自然商业光影，并尽量保留商品外形、颜色、包装和可见细节

quickPrompts.en: Please apply natural portrait retouching: improve skin tone, lightly smooth the skin, and soften blemishes and dark circles without changing facial features, face shape, or identity
quickPrompts.zh: 请对这张人像做自然美颜，改善肤色、轻度磨皮、淡化瑕疵和黑眼圈，不改变五官、脸型与人物身份特征

quickPrompts.en: Please restore this old photo by improving faded colors, noise, slight blur, and small scratches while preserving the people, period character, and original composition
quickPrompts.zh: 请修复这张老照片，改善褪色、噪点、轻微模糊和细小划痕，同时尽量保留人物特征、年代质感与原始构图
